incident_effect_summary: The insured intimated that a neighboring owner, Sarita Manandhar, whose house is situated on the east side of the client site, complained of property damage and filed a case with the municipality seeking repair and reimbursement. The ward/legal department report records that the construction involved piling, raft foundation and shear wall works, and states that settlement from piling and foundation construction may have caused cracks and deflection in the neighboring house.
spot_survey_observation: The Kathmandu Metropolitan City report records a site inspection and notes visible cracks at the apron and boundary wall, wall and beam joint cracks at the first floor south-east cantilever projection, hairline cracks on top floor walls, beam, column and stair cover, and westward deflection measured from the western parapet. The report recommends structural engineer opinion to determine whether the deflection is within ultimate and serviceability limit states and to advise crack remedies.
